"""One-click creative pass: transcript + signals + project context -> a complete edit.json.

    mcs autoplan <slug> [--mode funny] [--no-cold-open] [--seed 1]
    mcs engage <slug>          # only the engagement pass (auto zooms) on an existing edit

This is the deterministic baseline so "add footage + mic -> video" works with no human or LLM in the
loop. A Claude pass (/mc-edit) on top is still better at context and jokes; it can start from this.

Pipeline:
  1. segments   keep speech (+ action peaks), drop dead air; "fast forward" gaps become 4x montages
  2. beats      keyword lexicon + voice peaks + death screens -> taxonomy moments with a score
  3. modes      each segment gets a mood from its beats (sad on deaths, scary on panic, ...)
  4. cold open  strongest late beat is teased first, then "N MINUTES EARLIER"
  5. treatments per beat: SFX / zoom / shake / freeze / text / meme cutaway / green screen, within budgets
  6. engage     guarantee a visual change every mode.zoom.every_s seconds (punch-ins, jump-cut reframes)
  7. music      one bed per run of the same mode; captions emphasis; watermark; outro CTA
Every event is anchored to its segment ({"seg": id, ...}) so shorts can be cut from the edit later.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import random
import re
from pathlib import Path

from . import assets as A
from .edl import seg_duration
from .paths import STUDIO, project_dir
from .scaffold import keep_ranges

# (regex, moment, score, text-pop template or None). {W} = the matched word, upper-cased.
LEXICON: list[tuple[str, str, int, str | None]] = [
    (r"\b(i'?m (actually )?(gonna|going to) die|i'?m dying|help me)\b", "panic", 5, None),
    (r"\b(oh my god|oh my gosh|omg)\b", "shock", 4, None),
    (r"\b(died|dead|killed me|i'?m dead|rip)\b", "death", 4, None),
    (r"\bwhat the\b|\bwait,? what\b|\bhuh\b", "confusion", 3, "WHAT?!"),
    (r"\b(no no|nooo+|oh no|nope)\b", "fail", 3, None),
    (r"\b(let'?s go+|we did it|finally|yes!+)\b", "victory", 4, None),
    (r"\b(diamonds?)\b", "loot", 4, "+1 {W}"),
    (r"\b(netherite|emeralds?|treasure)\b", "loot", 3, "+1 {W}"),
    (r"\b(creeper|zombie|skeleton|enderman|warden|spider|phantom)s?\b", "jumpscare", 4, "{W}!"),
    (r"\b(explod\w*|tnt|blew up)\b", "explosion", 4, None),
    (r"\b(lava|drown\w*)\b", "panic", 3, "{W}?!"),
    (r"\b(water)\b", "shock", 2, "{W}?!"),
    (r"\b(fast forward|skip ahead|a few (minutes|hours) later)\b", "time_skip", 4, None),
    (r"\b(welcome back|hello|hey guys)\b", "intro", 2, None),
    (r"\b(bye|see you next time|that'?s the end)\b", "outro", 3, None),
    (r"\b(challenge)\b", "challenge", 3, None),
    (r"\b(only kidding|just kidding|jk)\b", "irony", 3, None),
    (r"\b(simple as that|too easy|easy)\b", "flex", 3, None),
    (r"\b(why|are you kidding|seriously|stupid)\b", "rage", 2, None),
    (r"\b(pickaxe|sword|crafting table|furnace)\b", "small_win", 1, None),
]

# which mood a beat pulls its segment into (strongest beat wins)
MOMENT_MODE = {"death": "sad", "fail": "sad", "panic": "scary", "jumpscare": "scary", "shock": "exciting",
               "explosion": "exciting", "victory": "exciting", "loot": "happy", "rage": "angry",
               "small_win": "happy", "flex": "happy"}

# per-moment treatment recipe
TREAT = {
    "panic":     {"zoom": 1.3, "shake": 14, "sfx": (["panic", "jumpscare"], ["reaction", "stinger", "hit"])},
    "shock":     {"zoom": 1.35, "sfx": (["shock", "emphasis"], ["hit", "stinger"])},
    "death":     {"zoom": 1.25, "freeze": 0.7, "sfx": (["death", "sad"], ["stinger", "voice_line"]),
                  "greenscreen": ["death"]},
    "confusion": {"zoom": 1.2, "sfx": (["confusion"], ["reaction", "voice_line"]), "meme": ["confusion", "awkward"]},
    "fail":      {"zoom": 1.2, "freeze": 0.5, "sfx": (["fail"], ["stinger", "voice_line"]), "meme": ["fail"]},
    "victory":   {"zoom": 1.3, "sfx": (["victory"], ["stinger", "voice_line", "hit"]), "greenscreen": ["victory"]},
    "loot":      {"zoom": 1.35, "sfx": (["loot", "small_win"], ["ui_sound", "stinger", "literal"])},
    "jumpscare": {"zoom": 1.5, "shake": 18, "sfx": (["jumpscare"], ["reaction", "hit", "stinger"])},
    "explosion": {"zoom": 1.4, "shake": 20, "sfx": (["explosion"], ["hit", "literal"])},
    "time_skip": {"sfx": (["time_skip"], ["whoosh", "stinger", "voice_line"])},
    "irony":     {"zoom": 1.2, "sfx": (["irony", "punchline"], ["hit", "stinger"])},
    "flex":      {"zoom": 1.2, "sfx": (["flex", "small_win"], ["ui_sound", "stinger"])},
    "rage":      {"zoom": 1.3, "shake": 12, "sfx": (["rage"], ["reaction", "hit"])},
    "challenge": {"zoom": 1.15, "sfx": (["suspense", "challenge"], ["stinger", "riser"])},
    "small_win": {"sfx": (["small_win"], ["ui_sound"])},
    "intro":     {},
    "outro":     {"freeze": 1.2, "sfx": (["outro", "fail", "sad"], ["stinger"])},
    "emphasis":  {"zoom": 1.25, "sfx": (["emphasis", "punchline"], ["hit"])},
}


def load_json(p: Path, default=None):
    try:
        return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return default


class Planner:
    def __init__(self, slug: str, mode: str | None = None, cold_open: bool = True, seed: int = 1):
        self.slug = slug
        self.proj = project_dir(slug)
        self.pj = load_json(self.proj / "project.json", {})
        self.tr = load_json(self.proj / "work" / "transcript.json", {"segments": []})
        self.sig = load_json(self.proj / "work" / "signals.json", {})
        self.modes = load_json(STUDIO / "modes.json", {})
        self.brand = load_json(STUDIO / "brand" / "brand.json", {})
        ctx = f"{self.pj.get('title', '')} {self.pj.get('context', '')}".lower()
        self.base_mode = mode or ("narration" if "narrat" in ctx or "story" in ctx else
                                  "pov" if re.search(r"\bpov\b", ctx) else "funny")
        self.cold_open = cold_open
        self.rng = random.Random(seed)
        self.words = [w for s in self.tr["segments"] for w in s.get("words", [])]
        self.used: list[str] = []
        self.warn: list[str] = []

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ assets
    def pick(self, moments, roles=None, categories=None, **kw) -> dict | None:
        q = A.Query(moments=moments, roles=roles or [], categories=categories or [], project=self.slug,
                    exclude=self.used, limit=4, seed=self.rng.randint(0, 10 ** 6), **kw)
        res = A.find(q)
        if not res:
            return None
        choice = res[0] if len(res) == 1 or self.rng.random() < 0.6 else self.rng.choice(res[:3])
        if choice.get("frequency") not in ("signature",):
            self.used.append(choice["id"])
        return choice

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ 1. beats
    def beats(self) -> list[dict]:
        out = []
        n = len(self.words)
        for i in range(n):
            window = " ".join(w["word"] for w in self.words[i:i + 6]).lower()
            window = re.sub(r"[^\w' ?!]", "", window)
            for rx, moment, score, tmpl in LEXICON:
                m = re.match(rf"\s*({rx})", window)
                if m:
                    span = len(m.group(1).split())
                    last = self.words[min(n - 1, i + span - 1)]
                    word = re.sub(r"[^\w']", "", self.words[i + span - 1]["word"] if i + span - 1 < n else "").upper()
                    out.append({"t": self.words[i]["start"], "end": last["end"], "moment": moment, "score": score,
                                "text": tmpl.replace("{W}", word.rstrip("S") if tmpl.startswith("+1") else word)
                                if tmpl else None, "phrase": m.group(1), "keyword": word.lower()})
                    break
        for p in self.sig.get("voice_peaks", []):           # loud moments with no keyword -> emphasis
            if not any(abs(b["t"] - p["t"]) < 1.5 for b in out) and p.get("above_baseline_db", 0) >= 18:
                out.append({"t": p["t"], "end": p["t"] + 0.4, "moment": "emphasis", "score": 2, "text": None,
                            "phrase": "", "keyword": ""})
        for d in self.sig.get("death_screens", []):
            out.append({"t": d["t"], "end": d["t"] + 0.5, "moment": "death", "score": 5, "text": None,
                        "phrase": "<death screen>", "keyword": "", "death_screen": True})
        # de-duplicate: one beat per 1.2 s, keep the strongest
        out.sort(key=lambda b: (b["t"], -b["score"]))
        kept: list[dict] = []
        for b in out:
            if kept and b["t"] - kept[-1]["t"] < 1.2:
                if b["score"] > kept[-1]["score"]:
                    kept[-1] = b
                continue
            kept.append(b)
        return kept

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ 2. segments
    def segments(self, beats: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
        dur = self.pj.get("duration_s") or (self.words[-1]["end"] + 2 if self.words else 0)
        events = self.sig.get("voice_peaks", []) + self.sig.get("game_peaks", [])
        ranges = keep_ranges(self.words, events, dur, pad=0.15, max_gap=0.6, keep_action=0.9) if self.words \
            else [[0, dur]]
        for d in self.sig.get("death_screens", []):         # always keep the death screen itself
            ranges.append([d["t"] - 0.1, min(dur, d["t"] + 1.6)])
        # time-skip montages: after "fast forward", keep the silent stretch at 4x
        montages = []
        for b in beats:
            if b["moment"] == "time_skip":
                nxt = next((w["start"] for w in self.words if w["start"] > b["end"] + 0.5), dur)
                a, z = b["end"] + 0.3, min(nxt - 0.2, b["end"] + 0.3 + 24)
                if z - a > 3:
                    montages.append([a, z])
        ranges = merge_ranges(ranges)
        segs = []
        for a, z in ranges:
            for ma, mz in montages:                          # carve montage parts out of kept ranges
                if a < ma < z:
                    segs.append({"in": a, "out": ma})
                    a = ma
            segs.append({"in": a, "out": z})
        for ma, mz in montages:
            segs.append({"in": ma, "out": mz, "speed": 4.0, "montage": True})
        segs = [s for s in segs if s["out"] - s["in"] > 0.35]
        # remove overlap between montages and kept ranges
        segs.sort(key=lambda s: s["in"])
        cleaned: list[dict] = []
        for s in segs:
            if cleaned and s["in"] < cleaned[-1]["out"]:
                if s.get("montage"):
                    cleaned[-1]["out"] = s["in"]
                else:
                    s["in"] = cleaned[-1]["out"]
            if s["out"] - s["in"] > 0.35:
                cleaned.append(s)
        # split at strong beats so a freeze/mood can attach to the beat's own segment
        final: list[dict] = []
        for s in cleaned:
            cuts = sorted(b["end"] + 0.12 for b in beats
                          if TREAT.get(b["moment"], {}).get("freeze") and s["in"] + 0.5 < b["end"] + 0.12 < s["out"] - 0.5)
            a = s["in"]
            for c in cuts:
                final.append({**s, "in": a, "out": c, "freeze_end": TREAT_FREEZE(beats, c)})
                a = c
            final.append({**s, "in": a})
        for k, s in enumerate(final):
            s["id"] = f"s{k + 1:03d}"
            s["type"] = "source"
            s.pop("montage", None) if s.get("speed", 1) == 1 else None
            for key in ("in", "out"):
                s[key] = round(s[key], 3)
        dark = self.sig.get("dark", [])
        for s in final:                                      # auto-brighten caves / underwater
            if any(a < s["out"] and s["in"] < b for a, b in dark):
                s.setdefault("effects", []).append("brighten")
        return final

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ 3. modes
    def assign_modes(self, segs: list[dict], beats: list[dict]) -> None:
        for s in segs:
            inside = [b for b in beats if s["in"] - 0.2 <= b["t"] < s["out"]]
            strong = max(inside, key=lambda b: b["score"], default=None)
            m = MOMENT_MODE.get(strong["moment"]) if strong and strong["score"] >= 3 else None
            if s.get("speed", 1) > 1:
                m = "exciting"
            s["mode"] = m or self.base_mode
        # smoothing: a mood needs ~2.5 s to read; single short odd-one-out segments fold into neighbours
        for i, s in enumerate(segs):
            d = (s["out"] - s["in"]) / s.get("speed", 1)
            if s["mode"] != self.base_mode and d < 1.2 and s["mode"] not in ("sad",):
                prev = segs[i - 1]["mode"] if i else self.base_mode
                s["mode"] = prev

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
    def seg_of(self, segs: list[dict], t: float) -> dict | None:
        return next((s for s in segs if s["in"] <= t < s["out"] + 1e-6 and not s["id"].startswith("cold")), None)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ main
    def plan(self) -> dict:
        beats = self.beats()
        segs = self.segments(beats)
        self.assign_modes(segs, beats)
        overlays, texts, sfx, emphasis = [], [], [], set()
        last = {"sfx": -9.0, "text": -9.0, "meme": -60.0, "gs": -60.0}
        duration = sum(seg_duration(s) for s in segs)
        meme_budget = max(1, int(duration / 40))
        gs_budget = max(1, int(duration / 50))
        cutaways: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []                # (after seg id, cutaway seg)

        for b in sorted(beats, key=lambda b: -b["score"]):   # strongest beats claim resources first
            s = self.seg_of(segs, b["t"])
            if not s:
                continue
            r = TREAT.get(b["moment"], {})
            mode = self.modes.get(s["mode"], {})
            zi = mode.get("zoom", {}).get("intensity", 1.0)
            if b["keyword"]:
                emphasis.add(b["keyword"])
            if r.get("zoom") and b["score"] >= 2 and s.get("speed", 1) == 1:
                to = 1 + (r["zoom"] - 1) * zi
                s.setdefault("zoom", []).append({"src_at": round(b["t"], 3), "to": round(to, 3), "in": 0.06,
                                                 "hold": max(0.4, b["end"] - b["t"] + 0.3), "out": 0.15})
            if r.get("shake") and mode.get("shake", 1) > 0:
                s.setdefault("shake", []).append({"src_at": round(b["t"], 3), "dur": 0.45,
                                                  "amp": round(r["shake"] * mode.get("shake", 1))})
            if r.get("sfx") and abs(b["t"] - last["sfx"]) > 2.2:
                moments, roles = r["sfx"]
                a = self.pick(moments + mode.get("sfx_moments", [])[:1], roles,
                              categories=["sfx_meme", "sfx_ui", "sfx_minecraft", "sfx_mlg", "sfx_laugh"],
                              max_duration=6)
                if a:
                    hit = "hit" in a.get("roles", [])
                    # impacts land on the word; reactions/stingers right AFTER it (never on the punchline)
                    t = b["t"] if hit else b["end"] + 0.1
                    if self.seg_of(segs, t) is s:
                        sfx.append({"asset": a["id"], "seg": s["id"], "src_at": round(t, 3),
                                    "align": "peak" if hit else "onset", "_beat": b["moment"]})
                        last["sfx"] = b["t"]
            if b.get("text") and abs(b["t"] - last["text"]) > 3.5:
                texts.append({"text": b["text"], "seg": s["id"], "src_at": round(b["t"], 3), "dur": 1.1,
                              "y": 0.32, **({"style": "minecraft"} if b["moment"] == "loot" else {})})
                last["text"] = b["t"]
            if r.get("meme") and meme_budget and b["score"] >= 3 and abs(b["t"] - last["meme"]) > 25 \
                    and s["out"] - b["end"] < 1.5:
                a = self.pick(r["meme"], categories=["meme_video"], max_duration=12, max_rating="clean")
                if a:
                    lo = a.get("use_in") or 0.0
                    hi = min((a.get("use_out") or a["duration_s"]), lo + 1.8)
                    cutaways.append((s["id"], {"id": f"meme-{len(cutaways) + 1}", "type": "cutaway",
                                               "asset": a["id"], "in": lo, "out": round(hi, 2)}))
                    meme_budget -= 1
                    last["meme"] = b["t"]
            if r.get("greenscreen") and gs_budget and not b.get("death_screen") and abs(b["t"] - last["gs"]) > 30:
                a = self.pick(r["greenscreen"], categories=["green_screen"], max_duration=10, max_rating="clean")
                if a:
                    full = a.get("placement") == "fullscreen"
                    overlays.append({"type": "greenscreen", "asset": a["id"], "seg": s["id"],
                                     "src_at": round(b["end"], 3), "dur": min(3.0, a["duration_s"]),
                                     **({} if full else {"x": 0.78, "y": 0.62, "scale": 0.5})})
                    gs_budget -= 1
                    last["gs"] = b["t"]
            if b["moment"] == "death" and b.get("death_screen"):
                s["freeze_end"] = max(s.get("freeze_end", 0), 1.6)
                s.setdefault("zoom", []).append({"src_at": round(b["t"] + 0.05, 3), "to": 1.35, "in": 1.4,
                                                 "focus": [0.5, 0.22]})
                s["mode"] = "sad"

        for after, cut in cutaways:                          # insert meme cutaways after their beat segment
            k = next(i for i, x in enumerate(segs) if x["id"] == after)
            segs.insert(k + 1, cut)

        # montage labels
        for s in segs:
            if s.get("speed", 1) > 1:
                texts.append({"text": f"x{int(s['speed'])} SPEED", "seg": s["id"], "rel": 0.0, "dur": 1.4,
                              "style": "label", "x": 0.86, "y": 0.1})

        # ---- cold open: tease the strongest late beat
        lead = []
        dur_src = self.pj.get("duration_s") or 0
        cands = [b for b in beats if b["moment"] in ("panic", "death", "shock", "jumpscare", "explosion")
                 and b["t"] > dur_src * 0.4 and b["score"] >= 4]
        if self.cold_open and cands and duration > 40:
            top = max(cands, key=lambda b: (b["score"], b["t"]))
            a = max(0.0, top["t"] - 1.2)
            z = top["end"] + 0.8
            lead.append({"id": "cold-1", "type": "source", "in": round(a, 3), "out": round(z, 3), "mode": "exciting",
                         "zoom": [{"src_at": round(top["t"], 3), "to": 1.3, "in": 0.06, "hold": 0.6, "out": 0.2}]})
            ds = next((d for d in self.sig.get("death_screens", []) if d["t"] > top["t"]), None)
            if ds:
                lead.append({"id": "cold-2", "type": "source", "in": round(ds["t"] - 0.05, 3),
                             "out": round(ds["t"] + 0.9, 3), "freeze_end": 0.4, "mode": "sad",
                             "zoom": [{"src_at": round(ds["t"], 3), "to": 1.35, "in": 0.3, "focus": [0.5, 0.22]}]})
            first_src = next((s["in"] for s in segs if s["type"] == "source"), 0)
            gap = top["t"] - first_src
            label = f"{max(1, round(gap / 60))} MINUTE{'S' if round(gap / 60) > 1 else ''} EARLIER" if gap >= 75 \
                else "EARLIER..."
            a_rewind = self.pick(["time_skip"], ["whoosh", "stinger"], categories=["sfx_meme", "sfx_ui"])
            if a_rewind:
                sfx.append({"asset": a_rewind["id"], "seg": segs[0]["id"], "rel": 0.0, "dur": 1.2})
            texts.append({"text": label, "seg": segs[0]["id"], "rel": 0.05, "dur": 1.7, "style": "minecraft",
                          "y": 0.3})
            sfx.append(self._sfx_for(["shock", "panic"], ["hit", "stinger"], "cold-1", top["t"], "peak"))
        segs = lead + segs
        sfx = [x for x in sfx if x]

        # ---- intro title + outro CTA
        title = self.pj.get("title") or self.slug
        first_main = next(s for s in segs if not s["id"].startswith("cold"))
        texts.append({"text": title.upper()[:38], "seg": first_main["id"], "rel": 1.8 if lead else 0.3, "dur": 2.0,
                      "style": "label", "y": 0.14})
        last_seg = segs[-1]
        cta = self.pick(["cta"], categories=["animation"], key_modes=["green"], max_duration=6)
        if cta and duration > 45:
            overlays.append({"type": "greenscreen", "asset": cta["id"], "seg": last_seg["id"], "rel": 0.0,
                             "x": 0.5, "y": 0.2, "scale": 0.5, "audio": False})

        edl = {"version": 1, "project": self.slug, "title": title, "mode": self.base_mode,
               "generator": "autoplan", "segments": segs, "overlays": overlays, "text": texts,
               "audio": {"sfx": sfx, "bleeps": [], "music": []},
               "captions": {"enabled": True, "emphasis_words": sorted(emphasis)[:20], "hide": []}}
        wm = self.brand.get("watermark", {})
        if wm.get("enabled"):
            edl["watermark"] = {"text": wm.get("text", ""), "opacity": wm.get("opacity", 0.55)}
        engage(edl, self.words, self.modes)
        self.music(edl)
        for x in edl["audio"]["sfx"]:
            x.pop("_beat", None)
        return edl

    def _sfx_for(self, moments, roles, seg_id, t, align):
        a = self.pick(moments, roles, categories=["sfx_meme", "sfx_ui", "sfx_mlg"], max_duration=4)
        return {"asset": a["id"], "seg": seg_id, "src_at": round(t, 3), "align": align} if a else None

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ music per mode run
    def music(self, edl: dict) -> None:
        t = 0.0
        runs: list[list] = []                                # [mode, start, end]
        for s in edl["segments"]:
            d = seg_duration(s, lambda i: A.get(i))
            m = s.get("mode") or edl["mode"]
            if s["id"].startswith("cold"):
                t += d
                continue
            if s["type"] == "cutaway":
                m = runs[-1][0] if runs else m
            if runs and (runs[-1][0] == m or (t + d) - runs[-1][1] < 0 or d < 4):
                runs[-1][2] = t + d
            else:
                runs.append([m, t, t + d])
            t += d
        merged: list[list] = []                              # tiny runs fold into the previous bed
        for r in runs:
            if merged and (r[2] - r[1] < 7 or merged[-1][0] == r[0]):
                merged[-1][2] = r[2]
            else:
                merged.append(r)
        for m, a, z in merged:
            cfg = self.modes.get(m, {}).get("music", {})
            lo, hi = cfg.get("energy", [1, 5])
            pick = self.pick(cfg.get("moments", ["exploring"]), ["music_bed"], categories=["music"], max_risk="low",
                             min_energy=lo, max_energy=hi, min_duration=30)
            if pick:
                edl["audio"]["music"].append({"asset": pick["id"], "at": round(a, 3), "until": round(z, 3),
                                              "in": round(min(20.0, (pick["duration_s"] or 60) * 0.1), 1),
                                              "fade_in": 0.8, "fade_out": 1.0, "duck": True, "_mode": m})
        for x in edl["audio"]["music"]:
            x.pop("_mode", None)


def TREAT_FREEZE(beats: list[dict], cut: float) -> float:
    b = min(beats, key=lambda b: abs(b["end"] + 0.12 - cut))
    return TREAT.get(b["moment"], {}).get("freeze", 0.0)


def merge_ranges(rs: list[list[float]]) -> list[list[float]]:
    out: list[list[float]] = []
    for a, z in sorted(rs):
        if out and a <= out[-1][1] + 0.05:
            out[-1][1] = max(out[-1][1], z)
        else:
            out.append([a, z])
    return out


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ engagement pass
def engage(edl: dict, words: list[dict], modes: dict) -> int:
    """Keep attention: no stretch longer than the mode's every_s without a visual change.

    * consecutive talking segments alternate 1.0x / 1.1x framing, so jump cuts read as deliberate
    * gaps get a punch-in on the most stressed word (longest word or one ending in ! / ?),
      or a slow push-in when there is no good word
    Auto zooms carry "auto": true and are replaced on re-run; hand-placed zooms are never touched.
    """
    added = 0
    segs = edl["segments"]
    prev_reframed = False
    for i, s in enumerate(segs):
        if s.get("type", "source") != "source" or s.get("speed", 1) > 1:
            prev_reframed = False
            continue
        s["zoom"] = [z for z in s.get("zoom", []) if not z.get("auto")]
        mode = modes.get(s.get("mode") or edl.get("mode", "funny"), {})
        every = mode.get("zoom", {}).get("every_s", 3.5)
        inten = mode.get("zoom", {}).get("intensity", 1.0)
        snap = mode.get("zoom", {}).get("snap", True)
        live = s["out"] - s["in"]
        adjacent = i > 0 and segs[i - 1].get("type", "source") == "source" and abs(segs[i - 1]["out"] - s["in"]) < 2.5
        if adjacent and not prev_reframed and not s["id"].startswith("cold"):
            s["zoom"].insert(0, {"at": 0.0, "to": round(1 + 0.1 * inten, 3), "in": 0, "out": 0, "auto": True})
            prev_reframed = True
            added += 1
        else:
            prev_reframed = False
        # find gaps between existing changes inside the segment
        marks = sorted([0.0, live] + [(z["src_at"] - s["in"]) if "src_at" in z else z.get("at", 0)
                                      for z in s["zoom"] if not (z.get("auto") and z.get("at") == 0.0)])
        for a, b in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            t = a + every
            while t < b - 0.8:
                cand = [w for w in words if s["in"] + t - every * 0.5 <= w["start"] <= s["in"] + min(b - 0.6, t + every * 0.5)]
                if cand:
                    w = max(cand, key=lambda w: (w["word"].endswith(("!", "?")), w["end"] - w["start"]))
                    at = w["start"] - s["in"]
                    if snap:
                        z = {"src_at": round(w["start"], 3), "to": round(1 + 0.2 * inten, 3), "in": 0.05,
                             "hold": round(max(0.4, w["end"] - w["start"] + 0.25), 2), "out": 0.15, "auto": True}
                    else:
                        z = {"src_at": round(w["start"], 3), "to": round(1 + 0.12 * inten, 3), "in": 1.2,
                             "hold": 0.6, "out": 0.6, "auto": True}
                else:
                    at = t
                    z = {"at": round(t, 3), "to": round(1 + 0.1 * inten, 3), "in": min(2.0, b - t), "out": 0.3,
                         "auto": True}
                s["zoom"].append(z)
                added += 1
                t = at + every
        if not s["zoom"]:
            s.pop("zoom")
    return added


def autoplan(slug: str, mode: str | None = None, cold_open: bool = True, seed: int = 1) -> Path:
    p = Planner(slug, mode, cold_open, seed)
    edl = p.plan()
    dest = p.proj / "edit.json"
    if dest.exists():
        hist = p.proj / "history"
        hist.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        from datetime import datetime
        dest.replace(hist / f"edit.{datetime.now():%Y%m%d-%H%M%S}.json")
    dest.write_text(json.dumps(edl, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    n = lambda k: len(edl[k]) if k in edl else 0  # noqa: E731
    print(f"[autoplan] {len(edl['segments'])} segments, {len(edl['audio']['sfx'])} sfx, {n('text')} text pops, "
          f"{n('overlays')} overlays, {len(edl['audio']['music'])} music beds, base mode {edl['mode']}")
    return dest


def engage_cmd(slug: str) -> None:
    proj = project_dir(slug)
    edl = json.loads((proj / "edit.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    tr = load_json(proj / "work" / "transcript.json", {"segments": []})
    words = [w for s in tr["segments"] for w in s.get("words", [])]
    k = engage(edl, words, load_json(STUDIO / "modes.json", {}))
    (proj / "edit.json").write_text(json.dumps(edl, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[engage] {k} auto zooms")

content.thinking: Next I'll build the shorts generator: it scores windows of the finished edit by beat density and payoff, then creates a 9:16 sub-project for each pick, reusing segment-anchored events, adding a hook headline, and switching facecam to the stacked layout.

input.content:
"""Cut 9:16 YouTube Shorts out of a finished landscape edit.

    mcs shorts <slug> [--count 3] [--min 12] [--max 45] [--render] [--preview]

Each short becomes a sibling project  projects/<slug>--short-N/  (format: vertical) that reuses the
main edit's segments and every event anchored to them (SFX, zooms, text, overlays travel along), so a
short inherits the full edit for free. Then it gets short-specific treatment:
  * hook headline pinned at the top for the first seconds (from the main edit's "shorts" hints,
    the project title, or the strongest beat)
  * vertical-safe captions (bigger, higher; YouTube UI covers the bottom ~20 %)
  * stacked facecam layout when a facecam exists
  * the music bed that was playing at that point, re-timed
  * no cold open / intro title / outro CTA - shorts start on the action and end on the payoff

Window choice: score = beat density (SFX, text, zooms, cutaways, overlays) + payoff bonus for a strong
beat in the last third, length within [min, max] seconds, windows never overlap.
Manual override: the main edit.json may contain
  "shorts": [{"from": "<seg id>", "to": "<seg id>", "hook": "HOOK TEXT"}]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from . import assets as A
from .edl import build_spans, resolve_time, seg_duration
from .paths import PROJECTS, project_dir

STRONG = {"death", "panic", "jumpscare", "explosion", "victory", "shock", "fail", "irony"}


def _events_by_seg(edl: dict) -> dict[str, float]:
    """weight of attention-grabbing events per segment id"""
    w: dict[str, float] = {}
    for grp, val in (("text", 1.0), ("overlays", 1.5)):
        for e in edl.get(grp, []):
            if e.get("seg"):
                w[e["seg"]] = w.get(e["seg"], 0) + val
    for e in edl.get("audio", {}).get("sfx", []):
        if e.get("seg"):
            w[e["seg"]] = w.get(e["seg"], 0) + 1.0
    for s in edl["segments"]:
        w[s["id"]] = w.get(s["id"], 0) + 0.6 * len([z for z in s.get("zoom", []) if not z.get("auto")])
        if s.get("type") == "cutaway":
            w[s["id"]] = w.get(s["id"], 0) + 2.0
        if s.get("freeze_end"):
            w[s["id"]] = w.get(s["id"], 0) + 1.5
    return w


def candidate_windows(edl: dict, lo: float, hi: float) -> list[dict]:
    segs = [s for s in edl["segments"] if not s["id"].startswith("cold")]
    lookup = lambda i: A.get(i)  # noqa: E731
    durs = [seg_duration(s, lookup) for s in segs]
    weights = _events_by_seg(edl)
    out = []
    for i in range(len(segs)):
        if segs[i].get("type") == "cutaway":
            continue                                     # never open a short on a meme
        total, score = 0.0, 0.0
        for j in range(i, len(segs)):
            total += durs[j]
            score += weights.get(segs[j]["id"], 0)
            if total > hi:
                break
            if total >= lo and segs[j].get("type") != "cutaway" or (total >= lo and j == len(segs) - 1):
                tail = segs[max(i, j - 2): j + 1]
                payoff = 2.5 if any(s.get("freeze_end") or s.get("mode") in ("sad", "scary", "exciting")
                                    for s in tail) else 0
                density = score / total
                out.append({"from": i, "to": j, "dur": total, "score": density * 10 + payoff + min(total, 35) / 35})
    return sorted(out, key=lambda c: -c["score"])


def pick_windows(edl: dict, count: int, lo: float, hi: float) -> list[dict]:
    segs = [s for s in edl["segments"] if not s["id"].startswith("cold")]
    if edl.get("shorts"):
        ids = [s["id"] for s in segs]
        return [{"from": ids.index(x["from"]), "to": ids.index(x["to"]), "hook": x.get("hook")} for x in edl["shorts"]]
    chosen: list[dict] = []
    for c in candidate_windows(edl, lo, hi):
        if all(c["to"] < k["from"] or c["from"] > k["to"] for k in chosen):
            chosen.append(c)
        if len(chosen) >= count:
            break
    return sorted(chosen, key=lambda c: c["from"])


def hook_text(edl: dict, segs: list[dict], pj: dict) -> str:
    texts = [t["text"] for t in edl.get("text", []) if t.get("seg") in {s["id"] for s in segs}
             and t.get("style") not in ("label",) and len(t["text"]) <= 22]
    title = (pj.get("title") or "").upper()
    if texts:
        return f"{texts[0]}"[:28]
    return (title[:32] + "…") if title else "WAIT FOR IT…"


def make_short(slug: str, n: int, win: dict, edl: dict, pj: dict) -> str:
    main_segs = [s for s in edl["segments"] if not s["id"].startswith("cold")]
    segs = [dict(s) for s in main_segs[win["from"]: win["to"] + 1]]
    ids = {s["id"] for s in segs}
    keep = lambda e: e.get("seg") in ids or ("src_at" in e and "seg" not in e and "at" not in e)  # noqa: E731
    skip_text = {"label"}                                # intro titles / speed labels stay in the long video
    texts = [dict(t) for t in edl.get("text", []) if keep(t)
             and not (t.get("style") in skip_text and "SPEED" not in t["text"])]
    hook = win.get("hook") or hook_text(edl, segs, pj)
    texts.insert(0, {"text": hook, "seg": segs[0]["id"], "rel": 0.0, "dur": 3.0, "style": "impact",
                     "y": 0.12, "anim": "pop", "size": 96})
    overlays = [dict(o) for o in edl.get("overlays", []) if keep(o) and o.get("type") != "transition"]
    for o in overlays:                                    # corner overlays read better centred on a phone
        if o.get("x") is not None and o.get("placement") != "fullscreen":
            o["x"], o["scale"] = 0.5, min(0.32, o.get("scale", 0.45))
    sfx = [dict(e) for e in edl.get("audio", {}).get("sfx", []) if keep(e)]

    # music: whatever bed was playing where the short starts, re-timed into the short
    spans_main = build_spans(edl, lambda i: A.get(i))
    start_out = next(sp.out_start for sp in spans_main if sp.seg_id == segs[0]["id"])
    total = sum(seg_duration(s, lambda i: A.get(i)) for s in segs)
    music = []
    for m in edl.get("audio", {}).get("music", []):
        at = resolve_time(m, spans_main, [], "music") if ("at" in m or "src_at" in m or "seg" in m) else 0.0
        until = m.get("until", 1e9)
        if at is not None and at <= start_out < until:
            music.append({**{k: v for k, v in m.items() if k not in ("at", "until", "src_at", "seg")},
                          "at": 0.0, "until": round(total, 3), "in": round(m.get("in", 0) + start_out - at, 2),
                          "fade_in": 0.2, "fade_out": 0.8})
            break
    if not music and edl.get("audio", {}).get("music"):
        m = edl["audio"]["music"][0]
        music.append({"asset": m["asset"], "at": 0.0, "until": round(total, 3), "fade_in": 0.2, "fade_out": 0.8})

    short = {"version": 1, "project": f"{slug}--short-{n}", "title": hook, "format": "vertical",
             "mode": edl.get("mode", "funny"), "parent": slug, "segments": segs, "overlays": overlays,
             "text": texts, "audio": {"sfx": sfx, "bleeps": [b for b in edl.get("audio", {}).get("bleeps", [])
                                                         if keep(b)], "music": music},
             "captions": {**edl.get("captions", {}), "hide": []}}
    if edl.get("watermark"):
        short["watermark"] = edl["watermark"]
    if edl.get("facecam"):
        short["facecam"] = {**edl["facecam"], "layout": "stack"}

    sslug = f"{slug}--short-{n}"
    dst = PROJECTS / sslug
    (dst / "work").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    src = project_dir(slug)
    spj = dict(pj)
    for k, s in spj.get("sources", {}).items():           # absolutise relative source paths
        if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("file") and not Path(s["file"]).is_absolute():
            s["file"] = str((src / s["file"]).resolve())
    spj.update({"slug": sslug, "title": hook, "kind": "short", "parent": slug})
    (dst / "project.json").write_text(json.dumps(spj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    for f in ("transcript.json", "transcript.md", "signals.json", "levels.json"):

"""Cut 9:16 YouTube Shorts out of a finished landscape edit.

    mcs shorts <slug> [--count 3] [--min 12] [--max 45] [--render] [--preview]

Each short becomes a sibling project  projects/<slug>--short-N/  (format: vertical) that reuses the
main edit's segments and every event anchored to them (SFX, zooms, text, overlays travel along), so a
short inherits the full edit for free. Then it gets short-specific treatment:
  * hook headline pinned at the top for the first seconds (from the main edit's "shorts" hints,
    the project title, or the strongest beat)
  * vertical-safe captions (bigger, higher; YouTube UI covers the bottom ~20 %)
  * stacked facecam layout when a facecam exists
  * the music bed that was playing at that point, re-timed
  * no cold open / intro title / outro CTA - shorts start on the action and end on the payoff

Window choice: score = beat density (SFX, text, zooms, cutaways, overlays) + payoff bonus for a strong
beat in the last third, length within [min, max] seconds, windows never overlap.
Manual override: the main edit.json may contain
  "shorts": [{"from": "<seg id>", "to": "<seg id>", "hook": "HOOK TEXT"}]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from . import assets as A
from .edl import build_spans, resolve_time, seg_duration
from .paths import PROJECTS, project_dir

STRONG = {"death", "panic", "jumpscare", "explosion", "victory", "shock", "fail", "irony"}


def _events_by_seg(edl: dict) -> dict[str, float]:
    """weight of attention-grabbing events per segment id"""
    w: dict[str, float] = {}
    for grp, val in (("text", 1.0), ("overlays", 1.5)):
        for e in edl.get(grp, []):
            if e.get("seg"):
                w[e["seg"]] = w.get(e["seg"], 0) + val
    for e in edl.get("audio", {}).get("sfx", []):
        if e.get("seg"):
            w[e["seg"]] = w.get(e["seg"], 0) + 1.0
    for s in edl["segments"]:
        w[s["id"]] = w.get(s["id"], 0) + 0.6 * len([z for z in s.get("zoom", []) if not z.get("auto")])
        if s.get("type") == "cutaway":
            w[s["id"]] = w.get(s["id"], 0) + 2.0
        if s.get("freeze_end"):
            w[s["id"]] = w.get(s["id"], 0) + 1.5
    return w


def candidate_windows(edl: dict, lo: float, hi: float) -> list[dict]:
    segs = [s for s in edl["segments"] if not s["id"].startswith("cold")]
    lookup = lambda i: A.get(i)  # noqa: E731
    durs = [seg_duration(s, lookup) for s in segs]
    weights = _events_by_seg(edl)
    out = []
    for i in range(len(segs)):
        if segs[i].get("type") == "cutaway":
            continue                                     # never open a short on a meme
        total, score = 0.0, 0.0
        for j in range(i, len(segs)):
            total += durs[j]
            score += weights.get(segs[j]["id"], 0)
            if total > hi:
                break
            if total >= lo and segs[j].get("type") != "cutaway" or (total >= lo and j == len(segs) - 1):
                tail = segs[max(i, j - 2): j + 1]
                payoff = 2.5 if any(s.get("freeze_end") or s.get("mode") in ("sad", "scary", "exciting")
                                    for s in tail) else 0
                density = score / total
                out.append({"from": i, "to": j, "dur": total, "score": density * 10 + payoff + min(total, 35) / 35})
    return sorted(out, key=lambda c: -c["score"])


def pick_windows(edl: dict, count: int, lo: float, hi: float) -> list[dict]:
    segs = [s for s in edl["segments"] if not s["id"].startswith("cold")]
    if edl.get("shorts"):
        ids = [s["id"] for s in segs]
        return [{"from": ids.index(x["from"]), "to": ids.index(x["to"]), "hook": x.get("hook")} for x in edl["shorts"]]
    chosen: list[dict] = []
    for c in candidate_windows(edl, lo, hi):
        if all(c["to"] < k["from"] or c["from"] > k["to"] for k in chosen):
            chosen.append(c)
        if len(chosen) >= count:
            break
    return sorted(chosen, key=lambda c: c["from"])


def hook_text(edl: dict, segs: list[dict], pj: dict) -> str:
    texts = [t["text"] for t in edl.get("text", []) if t.get("seg") in {s["id"] for s in segs}
             and t.get("style") not in ("label",) and len(t["text"]) <= 22]
    title = (pj.get("title") or "").upper()
    if texts:
        return f"{texts[0]}"[:28]
    return (title[:32] + "…") if title else "WAIT FOR IT…"


def make_short(slug: str, n: int, win: dict, edl: dict, pj: dict) -> str:
    main_segs = [s for s in edl["segments"] if not s["id"].startswith("cold")]
    segs = [dict(s) for s in main_segs[win["from"]: win["to"] + 1]]
    ids = {s["id"] for s in segs}
    keep = lambda e: e.get("seg") in ids or ("src_at" in e and "seg" not in e and "at" not in e)  # noqa: E731
    skip_text = {"label"}                                # intro titles / speed labels stay in the long video
    texts = [dict(t) for t in edl.get("text", []) if keep(t)
             and not (t.get("style") in skip_text and "SPEED" not in t["text"])]
    hook = win.get("hook") or hook_text(edl, segs, pj)
    texts.insert(0, {"text": hook, "seg": segs[0]["id"], "rel": 0.0, "dur": 3.0, "style": "impact",
                     "y": 0.12, "anim": "pop", "size": 96})
    overlays = [dict(o) for o in edl.get("overlays", []) if keep(o) and o.get("type") != "transition"]
    for o in overlays:                                    # corner overlays read better centred on a phone
        if o.get("x") is not None and o.get("placement") != "fullscreen":
            o["x"], o["scale"] = 0.5, min(0.32, o.get("scale", 0.45))
    sfx = [dict(e) for e in edl.get("audio", {}).get("sfx", []) if keep(e)]

    # music: whatever bed was playing where the short starts, re-timed into the short
    spans_main = build_spans(edl, lambda i: A.get(i))
    start_out = next(sp.out_start for sp in spans_main if sp.seg_id == segs[0]["id"])
    total = sum(seg_duration(s, lambda i: A.get(i)) for s in segs)
    music = []
    for m in edl.get("audio", {}).get("music", []):
        at = resolve_time(m, spans_main, [], "music") if ("at" in m or "src_at" in m or "seg" in m) else 0.0
        until = m.get("until", 1e9)
        if at is not None and at <= start_out < until:
            music.append({**{k: v for k, v in m.items() if k not in ("at", "until", "src_at", "seg")},
                          "at": 0.0, "until": round(total, 3), "in": round(m.get("in", 0) + start_out - at, 2),
                          "fade_in": 0.2, "fade_out": 0.8})
            break
    if not music and edl.get("audio", {}).get("music"):
        m = edl["audio"]["music"][0]
        music.append({"asset": m["asset"], "at": 0.0, "until": round(total, 3), "fade_in": 0.2, "fade_out": 0.8})

    short = {"version": 1, "project": f"{slug}--short-{n}", "title": hook, "format": "vertical",
             "mode": edl.get("mode", "funny"), "parent": slug, "segments": segs, "overlays": overlays,
             "text": texts, "audio": {"sfx": sfx, "bleeps": [b for b in edl.get("audio", {}).get("bleeps", [])
                                                         if keep(b)], "music": music},
             "captions": {**edl.get("captions", {}), "hide": []}}
    if edl.get("watermark"):
        short["watermark"] = edl["watermark"]
    if edl.get("facecam"):
        short["facecam"] = {**edl["facecam"], "layout": "stack"}

    sslug = f"{slug}--short-{n}"
    dst = PROJECTS / sslug
    (dst / "work").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    src = project_dir(slug)
    spj = dict(pj)
    for k, s in spj.get("sources", {}).items():           # absolutise relative source paths
        if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("file") and not Path(s["file"]).is_absolute():
            s["file"] = str((src / s["file"]).resolve())
    spj.update({"slug": sslug, "title": hook, "kind": "short", "parent": slug})
    (dst / "project.json").write_text(json.dumps(spj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    for f in ("transcript.json", "transcript.md", "signals.json", "levels.json"):
        if (src / "work" / f).exists():
            shutil.copy2(src / "work" / f, dst / "work" / f)
    (dst / "edit.json").write_text(json.dumps(short, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[shorts] {sslug}: {len(segs)} segments, {total:.1f}s, hook {hook!r}")
    return sslug


def make_shorts(slug: str, count: int = 3, lo: float = 12, hi: float = 45, render: bool = False,
                preview: bool = False) -> list[str]:
    proj = project_dir(slug)
    edl = json.loads((proj / "edit.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    pj = json.loads((proj / "project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    for old in PROJECTS.glob(f"{slug}--short-*"):
        if (old / "edit.json").exists() and not edl.get("shorts_keep"):
            shutil.rmtree(old / "work" / "full", ignore_errors=True)
    wins = pick_windows(edl, count, lo, hi)
    if not wins:
        print("[shorts] no window fits - try a lower --min")
        return []
    made = [make_short(slug, i + 1, w, edl, pj) for i, w in enumerate(wins)]
    if render:
        from .render import render as do_render
        for s in made:
            do_render(s, preview=preview, record=False)
    return made

"""The one-click assembly line: footage + mic (+ title/context) in, finished video + shorts out."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time

from .paths import project_dir


def step(name: str):
    print(f"\n=== {name} ===", flush=True)
    return time.time()


def run_auto(slug: str, mode: str | None = None, final: bool = False, shorts: int = 3,
             model: str = "large-v3-turbo", replan: bool = False) -> None:
    proj = project_dir(slug)

        step("transcribe")
        from .transcribe import transcribe
        transcribe(slug, model)
    if not (proj / "work" / "signals.json").exists():

        from .analyze import analyze
        analyze(slug)
    edl_p = proj / "edit.json"
    hand_made = edl_p.exists() and json.loads(edl_p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("generator") != "autoplan"
    if not edl_p.exists() or replan or not hand_made:
        step("autoplan")
        from .autoplan import autoplan
        autoplan(slug, mode)
    else:
        print("\n(keeping the existing hand-made edit.json - pass --replan to overwrite)")
    step("render " + ("final" if final else "preview"))
    from .render import render
    out = render(slug, preview=not final, record=final)
    made = []
    if shorts:
        step(f"shorts x{shorts}")
        from .shorts import make_shorts
        made = make_shorts(slug, shorts, render=True, preview=not final)
    print(f"\n✔ done in {time.time() - t0:.0f}s\n  video : {out}")
    for s in made:
        print(f"  short : projects/{s}/out/")

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time

from .paths import project_dir


def step(name: str):
    print(f"\n=== {name} ===", flush=True)
    return time.time()


def run_auto(slug: str, mode: str | None = None, final: bool = False, shorts: int = 3,
             model: str = "large-v3-turbo", replan: bool = False) -> None:
    proj = project_dir(slug)
    t0 = time.time()
    if not (proj / "work" / "transcript.json").exists():
        step("transcribe")
        from .transcribe import transcribe
        transcribe(slug, model)
    if not (proj / "work" / "signals.json").exists():
        step("analyze")
        from .analyze import analyze
        analyze(slug)
    edl_p = proj / "edit.json"
    hand_made = edl_p.exists() and json.loads(edl_p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("generator") != "autoplan"
    if not edl_p.exists() or replan or not hand_made:
        step("autoplan")
        from .autoplan import autoplan
        autoplan(slug, mode)
    else:
        print("\n(keeping the existing hand-made edit.json - pass --replan to overwrite)")
    step("render " + ("final" if final else "preview"))
    from .render import render
    out = render(slug, preview=not final, record=final)
    made = []

        made = make_shorts(slug, shorts, render=True, preview=not final)

"""Cut 9:16 YouTube Shorts out of a finished landscape edit.

    mcs shorts <slug> [--count 3] [--min 12] [--max 45] [--render] [--preview]

Each short becomes a sibling project  projects/<slug>--short-N/  (format: vertical) that reuses the
main edit's segments and every event anchored to them (SFX, zooms, text, overlays travel along), so a
short inherits the full edit for free. Then it gets short-specific treatment:
  * hook headline pinned at the top for the first seconds (from the main edit's "shorts" hints,
    the project title, or the strongest beat)
  * vertical-safe captions (bigger, higher; YouTube UI covers the bottom ~20 %)
  * stacked facecam layout when a facecam exists
  * the music bed that was playing at that point, re-timed
  * no cold open / intro title / outro CTA - shorts start on the action and end on the payoff

Window choice: score = beat density (SFX, text, zooms, cutaways, overlays) + payoff bonus for a strong
beat in the last third, length within [min, max] seconds, windows never overlap.
Manual override: the main edit.json may contain
  "shorts": [{"from": "<seg id>", "to": "<seg id>", "hook": "HOOK TEXT"}]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from . import assets as A
from .edl import build_spans, resolve_time, seg_duration
from .paths import PROJECTS, project_dir

STRONG = {"death", "panic", "jumpscare", "explosion", "victory", "shock", "fail", "irony"}


def _events_by_seg(edl: dict) -> dict[str, float]:
    """weight of attention-grabbing events per segment id"""
    w: dict[str, float] = {}
    for grp, val in (("text", 1.0), ("overlays", 1.5)):
        for e in edl.get(grp, []):
            if e.get("seg"):
                w[e["seg"]] = w.get(e["seg"], 0) + val
    for e in edl.get("audio", {}).get("sfx", []):
        if e.get("seg"):
            w[e["seg"]] = w.get(e["seg"], 0) + 1.0
    for s in edl["segments"]:
        w[s["id"]] = w.get(s["id"], 0) + 0.6 * len([z for z in s.get("zoom", []) if not z.get("auto")])
        if s.get("type") == "cutaway":
            w[s["id"]] = w.get(s["id"], 0) + 2.0
        if s.get("freeze_end"):
            w[s["id"]] = w.get(s["id"], 0) + 1.5
    return w


def candidate_windows(edl: dict, lo: float, hi: float) -> list[dict]:
    segs = [s for s in edl["segments"] if not s["id"].startswith("cold")]
    lookup = lambda i: A.get(i)  # noqa: E731
    durs = [seg_duration(s, lookup) for s in segs]
    weights = _events_by_seg(edl)
    out = []
    for i in range(len(segs)):
        if segs[i].get("type") == "cutaway":
            continue                                     # never open a short on a meme
        total, score = 0.0, 0.0
        for j in range(i, len(segs)):
            total += durs[j]
            score += weights.get(segs[j]["id"], 0)
            if total > hi:
                break
            if total >= lo and segs[j].get("type") != "cutaway" or (total >= lo and j == len(segs) - 1):
                tail = segs[max(i, j - 2): j + 1]
                payoff = 2.5 if any(s.get("freeze_end") or s.get("mode") in ("sad", "scary", "exciting")
                                    for s in tail) else 0
                density = score / total
                out.append({"from": i, "to": j, "dur": total, "score": density * 10 + payoff + min(total, 35) / 35})
    return sorted(out, key=lambda c: -c["score"])


def pick_windows(edl: dict, count: int, lo: float, hi: float) -> list[dict]:
    segs = [s for s in edl["segments"] if not s["id"].startswith("cold")]
    if edl.get("shorts"):
        ids = [s["id"] for s in segs]
        return [{"from": ids.index(x["from"]), "to": ids.index(x["to"]), "hook": x.get("hook")} for x in edl["shorts"]]
    chosen: list[dict] = []
    for c in candidate_windows(edl, lo, hi):
        if all(c["to"] < k["from"] or c["from"] > k["to"] for k in chosen):
            chosen.append(c)
        if len(chosen) >= count:
            break
    return sorted(chosen, key=lambda c: c["from"])


def hook_text(edl: dict, segs: list[dict], pj: dict) -> str:
    texts = [t["text"] for t in edl.get("text", []) if t.get("seg") in {s["id"] for s in segs}
             and t.get("style") not in ("label",) and len(t["text"]) <= 22]
    title = (pj.get("title") or "").upper()
    if texts:
        return f"{texts[0]}"[:28]
    return (title[:32] + "…") if title else "WAIT FOR IT…"


def make_short(slug: str, n: int, win: dict, edl: dict, pj: dict) -> str:
    main_segs = [s for s in edl["segments"] if not s["id"].startswith("cold")]
    segs = [dict(s) for s in main_segs[win["from"]: win["to"] + 1]]
    ids = {s["id"] for s in segs}
    keep = lambda e: e.get("seg") in ids or ("src_at" in e and "seg" not in e and "at" not in e)  # noqa: E731
    skip_text = {"label"}                                # intro titles / speed labels stay in the long video
    texts = [dict(t) for t in edl.get("text", []) if keep(t)
             and not (t.get("style") in skip_text and "SPEED" not in t["text"])]
    hook = win.get("hook") or hook_text(edl, segs, pj)
    texts.insert(0, {"text": hook, "seg": segs[0]["id"], "rel": 0.0, "dur": 3.0, "style": "impact",
                     "y": 0.12, "anim": "pop", "size": 96})
    overlays = [dict(o) for o in edl.get("overlays", []) if keep(o) and o.get("type") != "transition"]
    for o in overlays:                                    # corner overlays read better centred on a phone
        if o.get("x") is not None and o.get("placement") != "fullscreen":
            o["x"], o["scale"] = 0.5, min(0.32, o.get("scale", 0.45))
    sfx = [dict(e) for e in edl.get("audio", {}).get("sfx", []) if keep(e)]

    # music: whatever bed was playing where the short starts, re-timed into the short
    spans_main = build_spans(edl, lambda i: A.get(i))
    start_out = next(sp.out_start for sp in spans_main if sp.seg_id == segs[0]["id"])
    total = sum(seg_duration(s, lambda i: A.get(i)) for s in segs)
    music = []
    for m in edl.get("audio", {}).get("music", []):
        at = resolve_time(m, spans_main, [], "music") if ("at" in m or "src_at" in m or "seg" in m) else 0.0
        until = m.get("until", 1e9)
        if at is not None and at <= start_out < until:
            music.append({**{k: v for k, v in m.items() if k not in ("at", "until", "src_at", "seg")},
                          "at": 0.0, "until": round(total, 3), "in": round(m.get("in", 0) + start_out - at, 2),
                          "fade_in": 0.2, "fade_out": 0.8})
            break
    if not music and edl.get("audio", {}).get("music"):
        m = edl["audio"]["music"][0]
        music.append({"asset": m["asset"], "at": 0.0, "until": round(total, 3), "fade_in": 0.2, "fade_out": 0.8})

    short = {"version": 1, "project": f"{slug}--short-{n}", "title": hook, "format": "vertical",
             "mode": edl.get("mode", "funny"), "parent": slug, "segments": segs, "overlays": overlays,
             "text": texts, "audio": {"sfx": sfx, "bleeps": [b for b in edl.get("audio", {}).get("bleeps", [])
                                                         if keep(b)], "music": music},
             "captions": {**edl.get("captions", {}), "hide": []}}
    if edl.get("watermark"):
        short["watermark"] = edl["watermark"]
    if edl.get("facecam"):
        short["facecam"] = {**edl["facecam"], "layout": "stack"}

    sslug = f"{slug}--short-{n}"
    dst = PROJECTS / sslug
    (dst / "work").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    src = project_dir(slug)
    spj = dict(pj)
    for k, s in spj.get("sources", {}).items():           # absolutise relative source paths
        if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("file") and not Path(s["file"]).is_absolute():
            s["file"] = str((src / s["file"]).resolve())
    spj.update({"slug": sslug, "title": hook, "kind": "short", "parent": slug})
    (dst / "project.json").write_text(json.dumps(spj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    for f in ("transcript.json", "transcript.md", "signals.json", "levels.json"):
        if (src / "work" / f).exists():
            shutil.copy2(src / "work" / f, dst / "work" / f)
    (dst / "edit.json").write_text(json.dumps(short, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[shorts] {sslug}: {len(segs)} segments, {total:.1f}s, hook {hook!r}")
    return sslug


def make_shorts(slug: str, count: int = 3, lo: float = 12, hi: float = 45, render: bool = False,
                preview: bool = False) -> list[str]:
    proj = project_dir(slug)
    edl = json.loads((proj / "edit.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    pj = json.loads((proj / "project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    for old in PROJECTS.glob(f"{slug}--short-*"):
        if (old / "edit.json").exists() and not edl.get("shorts_keep"):
            shutil.rmtree(old / "work" / "full", ignore_errors=True)
    wins = pick_windows(edl, count, lo, hi)
    if not wins:
        print("[shorts] no window fits - try a lower --min")
        return []
    made = [make_short(slug, i + 1, w, edl, pj) for i, w in enumerate(wins)]
    if render:
        from .render import render as do_render
        for s in made:
            do_render(s, preview=preview, record=False)
    return made

def media_lib(root: str, rel: str):

def media_studio(rel: str):

    }''','''        "job": next((j.public() for j in reversed(JOBS.values()) if j.slug == p.name and j.status == "running"), None),
        "kind": pj.get("kind", "episode"), "parent": pj.get("parent"), "context": pj.get("context", ""),

@app.get("/api/brand")
def brand():
    b = read_json(STUDIO / "brand" / "brand.json", {})
    av = STUDIO / "brand" / "avatar"
    b["avatar_states"] = sorted(f"brand/avatar/{f.name}" for f in av.glob("*.png") if f.name != "skin.png") \\
        if av.exists() else []
    return b


class BrandPatch(BaseModel):
    channel_name: str | None = None
    tagline: str | None = None
    watermark_text: str | None = None


@app.patch("/api/brand")
def patch_brand(body: BrandPatch):
    p = STUDIO / "brand" / "brand.json"
    b = read_json(p, {})
    if body.channel_name:
        b["channel_name"] = body.channel_name
    if body.tagline is not None:
        b["tagline"] = body.tagline
    if body.watermark_text is not None:
        b.setdefault("watermark", {})["text"] = body.watermark_text
    p.write_text(json.dumps(b, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    return brand()


@app.get("/api/modes")
def modes():
    return read_json(STUDIO / "modes.json", {})


@app.get("/api/motion")
def motion_templates():
    tdir = STUDIO / "motion" / "templates"
    out = []
    for d in sorted(tdir.iterdir()) if tdir.exists() else []:
        if d.is_dir():
            prev = next((f"motion/templates/{d.name}/{f.name}" for f in sorted(d.glob("preview*.png"))), None)
            out.append({"name": d.name, "preview": prev})
    cache = STUDIO / "motion" / "cache"
    return {"templates": out, "cached": sorted(f.name for f in cache.glob("*"))[:50] if cache.exists() else []}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ stock library
LIB_FOLDERS = ["Inbox", "Minecraft B-Roll", "Real World B-Roll", "Reactions & Memes", "Sound Effects", "Music",
               "Overlays & Green Screen"]


@app.post("/api/library/upload")
async def library_upload(folder: str = Form("Inbox"), files: list[UploadFile] = File(...)):
    if folder not in LIB_FOLDERS:
        raise HTTPException(400, f"folder must be one of {LIB_FOLDERS}")
    dest = ROOT / "Stock Library" / folder
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    saved = []
    for f in files:
        name = Path(f.filename or "upload.bin").name
        target = dest / name
        with target.open("wb") as out:
            while chunk := await f.read(1 << 20):
                out.write(chunk)
        saved.append(name)
    job = Job("_library", "library-scan", [sys.executable, "-m", "mcstudio.cli", "library", "scan"], STUDIO)
    JOBS[job.id] = job
    return {"saved": saved, "job": job.public()}


@app.get("/api/library/status")
def library_status():
    from .library import status
    import contextlib
    import io
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        st = status()
    st["folders"] = LIB_FOLDERS
    st["claude"] = bool(claude_bin())
    st["tag_prompt"] = ("Tag the new Stock Library assets: follow studio/catalog/TAGGING.md for the `library` batch "

                        "studio/catalog/tags/library_<date>.json, then run python studio/catalog/merge_catalog.py.")
    return st


@app.post("/api/library/tag")
def library_tag():
    cb = claude_bin()

    return job.public()

  - **angry:** slanted brows, a red anger mark, and gritted teeth when talking.

  - Tall dark "bean" eyes with a white glint, rosy cheeks and a small mouth.

  - It looks nothing like Steve or Alex.

  - 3/4 view of the head: front, side and top faces, pixel-crisp, with a subtle 3D tilt. The head is about 1.3x normal size for a cartoon look.
  - The hat layer sits slightly larger than the head, and side and top faces are shaded.

    tr_p = ctx.proj / "work" / "transcript.json"
    words = []
    if tr_p.exists():
        for seg in json.loads(tr_p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["segments"]:
            for w in seg.get("words", []):
                for sp in spans:
                    a = sp.src_to_out(w["start"])
                    if a is None:
                        continue
                    b = sp.src_to_out(w["end"])
                    words.append({"word": w["word"], "start": a, "end": min(b if b is not None else sp.out_end,
                                                                             sp.out_end)})
    W, H, FPS = ctx.W, ctx.H, ctx.FPS
    vertical = ctx.format == "vertical"
    h = int(H * cfg.get("scale", 0.2 if vertical else 0.34)) // 2 * 2
    cx = W * cfg.get("x", 0.2 if vertical else 0.13)
    bottom = H * cfg.get("bottom", 0.8 if vertical else 1.0)
    stage = ctx.work / "stage"
    stage.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for k, r in enumerate(runs):
        sched = AV.mouth_schedule([w for w in words if r["start"] <= w["start"] < r["end"]], fps=FPS,
                                  start=r["start"], end=r["end"])
        a, z = r["start"], r["end"]
        # slide up in 0.25 s, gentle bob, slide down at the end
        slide = f"{h}*(1-min(1,(t-{a:.3f})/0.25))+{h}*max(0,(t-{z - 0.25:.3f})/0.25)"
        y = f"{bottom:.0f}-overlay_h+{slide}+{H * 0.004:.1f}*sin(2*PI*1.1*t)"
        for variant in ("idle", "talk", "blink", "talk_blink"):
            stem = AV.state_name(r["mood"], "" if variant == "idle" else variant)
            if not (adir / f"{stem}.png").exists():
                stem = AV.state_name("neutral", "" if variant == "idle" else variant)
            dst = stage / f"av_{stem}.png"
            if not dst.exists():
                shutil.copyfile(adir / f"{stem}.png", dst)
            en = f"between(t,{a:.3f},{z:.3f})" if variant == "idle" else AV.enable_expr(sched, variant)
            if en == "0":
                continue
            lab = f"av{k}{variant}"
            chains.append(f"movie=stage/{dst.name}:loop=0,setpts=N/{FPS}/TB,format=rgba,scale=-2:{h}[{lab}]")
            nxt = f"[{lab}o]"
            chains.append(f"{cur}[{lab}]overlay=x='{cx:.0f}-overlay_w/2':y='{y}':enable='{en}':shortest=1{nxt}")
            cur = nxt
    return cur

    the expression follows the mode (sad -> sad face, scary -> shocked, ...).

    The whole avatar performance is pre-rendered ONCE as a single transparent ProRes track (concat of
    timed state images), then composited with one overlay - cost doesn't grow with narration length."""
    import hashlib as _h

    from PIL import Image

    from . import avatar as AV
    adir = STUDIO / "brand" / "avatar"
    if not (adir / "idle.png").exists():
        return cur
    cfg = ctx.edl.get("avatar", {})
    runs: list[dict] = []
    for sp in spans:
        seg = ctx.edl["segments"][sp.seg_index]
        m = ctx.mode(seg)

                runs[-1]["end"] = end
                continue
            runs[-1]["cont"] = True                     # mood change mid-run: no slide out/in
        runs.append({"start": sp.out_start, "end": end, "mood": mood})
    if not runs:

    tr_p = ctx.proj / "work" / "transcript.json"

"""Recursively extract asset archives (zips inside zips) into a staging folder. Originals are untouched.

    python studio/catalog/extract_archives.py "Asset Pack v2" "Asset Pack v2/_extracted"
"""
import shutil
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

SKIP = {".url", ".lnk", ".ini", ".ds_store"}


def safe_name(name: str) -> str:
    bad = '<>:"|?*'
    return "".join("_" if c in bad else c for c in name).rstrip(" .")


def extract(zpath: Path, dest: Path, depth: int = 0) -> int:
    n = 0
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zpath) as zf:
        for info in zf.infolist():
            if info.is_dir() or "__MACOSX" in info.filename:
                continue
            rel = Path(*[safe_name(p) for p in Path(info.filename).parts])
            if rel.suffix.lower() in SKIP or rel.name.startswith("._"):
                continue
            out = dest / rel
            out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            if out.suffix.lower() == ".zip":
                tmp = out.with_suffix(".zip.tmp")
                with zf.open(info) as src, tmp.open("wb") as dst:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst, 1 << 20)
                inner = out.with_suffix("")                 # "SFX (1).zip" -> folder "SFX (1)"
                n += extract(tmp, inner, depth + 1)
                tmp.unlink()
                continue
            if out.exists() and out.stat().st_size == info.file_size:
                n += 1
                continue
            with zf.open(info) as src, out.open("wb") as dst:
                shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst, 1 << 20)
            n += 1
    print(f"{'  ' * depth}{zpath.name}: {n} files", flush=True)
    return n


if __name__ == "__main__":
    src, dst = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2])
    dst.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    total = 0
    for z in sorted(src.glob("*.zip")):
        total += extract(z, dst / safe_name(z.stem))
    for d in src.iterdir():                                 # loose folders are copied in as-is
        if d.is_dir() and d.resolve() != dst.resolve():
            target = dst / safe_name(d.name)
            if not target.exists():
                shutil.copytree(d, target)
            total += sum(1 for f in target.rglob("*") if f.is_file())
            print(f"{d.name}: copied")
    print(f"TOTAL {total} files -> {dst}")

def wave(path: str) -> np.ndarray:
    if path not in _wave:

def same_waveform(a: str, b: str, need: float = 0.9) -> bool:
    """Max normalised cross-correlation within +-60 ms: re-encodes of one sound ~0.95+, different sounds low."""
    x, y = wave(a), wave(b)
    n = min(len(x), len(y))

    c = np.fft.irfft(np.fft.rfft(x, L) * np.conj(np.fft.rfft(y, L)), L)
    lag = 480
    best = max(np.abs(c[:lag]).max(), np.abs(c[-lag:]).max())
    return best / (nx * ny) >= need

            out.append(np.frombuffer(r.stdout[: 64 * 36 * 3], np.uint8).astype(np.int16).reshape(36, 64, 3)

        _thumbs[path] = out
    return _thumbs[path]


def same_frames(a: dict, b: dict) -> bool:
    ta, tb = thumbs(a["path"], a["dur"]), thumbs(b["path"], b["dur"])

"""Merge new archives into the Editing Pack and reorganise everything into one clean folder tree.

    python studio/catalog/organize.py stage    # 1) dedupe-aware intake: unique new files -> Editing Pack/_Incoming
    python studio/catalog/organize.py plan     # 2) compute destination folders from tags  -> organize_plan.json
    python studio/catalog/organize.py apply    # 3) move files per plan (logged)
    python studio/catalog/organize.py undo     # move everything back using the log

Nothing is ever deleted. Duplicates go to "Editing Pack/_Duplicates (review, then delete)/" and every move
is appended to studio/catalog/moves.jsonl so the whole operation can be reversed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import re
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PACK = ROOT / "Editing Pack"
CAT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
STAGING = ROOT / "Asset Pack v2" / "_extracted"
INCOMING = PACK / "_Incoming"
DUPES = PACK / "_Duplicates (review, then delete)"
LOG = CAT / "moves.jsonl"
JUNK = re.compile(r"dummyDiagnosisFile|\.app_conversion_data|desktop\.ini|thumbs\.db|\.sfk$", re.I)


def move(src: Path, dst: Path, why: str) -> Path:
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if dst.exists():
        stem, suf, k = dst.stem, dst.suffix, 2
        while (dst.parent / f"{stem} ({k}){suf}").exists():
            k += 1
        dst = dst.parent / f"{stem} ({k}){suf}"
    os.replace(src, dst)
    with LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({"t": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "from": str(src), "to": str(dst),
                            "why": why}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    return dst


def stage() -> None:
    d = json.loads((CAT / "dedupe.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    near_img = {(a, b) for a, b, why in d["reasons"] if why.startswith("same image")}
    drop: dict[str, str] = {}
    aliases: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for g in d["groups"]:
        for p in g["drop"]:
            if (g["keep"], p) in near_img or (p, g["keep"]) in near_img:
                continue                                   # near-identical pictures are different items: keep
            drop[p] = g["keep"]
            if "Minecraft_Items" in p and "Minecraft_Items" in g["keep"]:
                aliases.setdefault(Path(g["keep"]).stem, []).append(Path(p).stem)
    n_in = n_dup = n_junk = 0
    # 1) duplicates and junk inside the existing pack
    for f in list(PACK.rglob("*")):
        if not f.is_file() or INCOMING in f.parents or DUPES in f.parents:
            continue
        if JUNK.search(str(f)):
            move(f, DUPES / "_junk" / f.relative_to(PACK), "app junk")
            n_junk += 1
        elif str(f) in drop:
            move(f, DUPES / f.relative_to(PACK), f"duplicate of {drop[str(f)]}")
            n_dup += 1
    # 2) unique new files -> _Incoming (staging keeps only the duplicates)
    for f in list(STAGING.rglob("*")):
        if not f.is_file():
            continue
        if JUNK.search(str(f)) or str(f) in drop:
            continue
        move(f, INCOMING / f.relative_to(STAGING), "new unique asset")
        n_in += 1
    (CAT / "aliases.json").write_text(json.dumps(aliases, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    left = sum(1 for f in STAGING.rglob("*") if f.is_file())
    print(f"incoming {n_in} unique new files, moved {n_dup} in-pack duplicates + {n_junk} junk to {DUPES.name}; "
          f"{left} duplicate files left in staging; {sum(len(v) for v in aliases.values())} texture aliases")


def undo() -> None:
    lines = LOG.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if LOG.exists() else []
    for line in reversed(lines):
        m = json.loads(line)
        src, dst = Path(m["to"]), Path(m["from"])
        if src.exists() and not dst.exists():
            dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            os.replace(src, dst)
    LOG.rename(LOG.with_suffix(f".undone-{datetime.now():%Y%m%d%H%M%S}.jsonl"))
    print(f"undid {len(lines)} moves")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    cmd = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "help"
    if cmd == "stage":
        stage()
    elif cmd == "undo":
        undo()
    elif cmd in ("plan", "apply"):
        from organize_plan import apply, plan  # noqa: PLC0415  (second half lives next to this file)
        plan() if cmd == "plan" else apply()
    else:
        print(__doc__)

"""Merge new archives into the Editing Pack and reorganise everything into one clean folder tree.

    python studio/catalog/organize.py stage    # 1) dedupe-aware intake: unique new files -> Editing Pack/_Incoming
    python studio/catalog/organize.py plan     # 2) compute destination folders from tags  -> organize_plan.json
    python studio/catalog/organize.py apply    # 3) move files per plan (logged)
    python studio/catalog/organize.py undo     # move everything back using the log

Nothing is ever deleted. Duplicates go to "Editing Pack/_Duplicates (review, then delete)/" and every move
is appended to studio/catalog/moves.jsonl so the whole operation can be reversed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import re
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PACK = ROOT / "Editing Pack"
CAT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
STAGING = ROOT / "Asset Pack v2" / "_extracted"
INCOMING = PACK / "_Incoming"
DUPES = PACK / "_Duplicates (review, then delete)"
LOG = CAT / "moves.jsonl"
JUNK = re.compile(r"dummyDiagnosisFile|\.app_conversion_data|desktop\.ini|thumbs\.db|\.sfk$", re.I)


def move(src: Path, dst: Path, why: str) -> Path:
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if dst.exists():
        stem, suf, k = dst.stem, dst.suffix, 2
        while (dst.parent / f"{stem} ({k}){suf}").exists():
            k += 1
        dst = dst.parent / f"{stem} ({k}){suf}"
    os.replace(src, dst)
    with LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({"t": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "from": str(src), "to": str(dst),
                            "why": why}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    return dst


def stage() -> None:
    d = json.loads((CAT / "dedupe.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    near_img = {(a, b) for a, b, why in d["reasons"] if why.startswith("same image")}
    drop: dict[str, str] = {}
    aliases: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for g in d["groups"]:
        for p in g["drop"]:
            if (g["keep"], p) in near_img or (p, g["keep"]) in near_img:
                continue                                   # near-identical pictures are different items: keep
            drop[p] = g["keep"]
            if "Minecraft_Items" in p and "Minecraft_Items" in g["keep"]:
                aliases.setdefault(Path(g["keep"]).stem, []).append(Path(p).stem)
    n_in = n_dup = n_junk = 0
    # 1) duplicates and junk inside the existing pack
    for f in list(PACK.rglob("*")):
        if not f.is_file() or INCOMING in f.parents or DUPES in f.parents:
            continue
        if JUNK.search(str(f)):
            move(f, DUPES / "_junk" / f.relative_to(PACK), "app junk")
            n_junk += 1
        elif str(f) in drop:
            move(f, DUPES / f.relative_to(PACK), f"duplicate of {drop[str(f)]}")
            n_dup += 1
    # 2) unique new files -> _Incoming (staging keeps only the duplicates)
    for f in list(STAGING.rglob("*")):
        if not f.is_file():
            continue
        if JUNK.search(str(f)) or str(f) in drop:
            continue
        move(f, INCOMING / f.relative_to(STAGING), "new unique asset")
        n_in += 1
    (CAT / "aliases.json").write_text(json.dumps(aliases, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    left = sum(1 for f in STAGING.rglob("*") if f.is_file())
    print(f"incoming {n_in} unique new files, moved {n_dup} in-pack duplicates + {n_junk} junk to {DUPES.name}; "
          f"{left} duplicate files left in staging; {sum(len(v) for v in aliases.values())} texture aliases")


def undo() -> None:
    lines = LOG.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if LOG.exists() else []
    for line in reversed(lines):
        m = json.loads(line)
        src, dst = Path(m["to"]), Path(m["from"])
        if src.exists() and not dst.exists():
            dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            os.replace(src, dst)
    LOG.rename(LOG.with_suffix(f".undone-{datetime.now():%Y%m%d%H%M%S}.jsonl"))
    print(f"undid {len(lines)} moves")

    cmd = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "help"

    elif cmd == "undo":
        undo()
